model: CoolMasterNet Daikin VRV outdoor system (PRO) objects - VRV4S3, VRVX, VRV4-EU
equipment_type: VRF outdoor system monitoring via BACnet gateway
applies_to: Daikin VRV outdoor systems (VRV4S3, VRVX, VRV4-EU, as grouped by CoolAutomation) read through a CoolAutomation gateway with PRO functionality.
summary: With PRO functionality, CoolAutomation gateways publish system-level service data for Daikin VRV outdoor systems over BACnet: system type, AirNet address, capacity, system current, target evaporating and condensing temperatures, error code, cooling/heating/ventilation and thermostat states and demand state (19 objects for this series group). Monitoring only.
notes: Instance = VA x 256 + index (object identifier bits 21-8 = VA, 7-0 = index). Points shown for VA 1; the guide does not explain how outdoor units receive their VA.
Access set to read-only: these are measured service values, although the guide's type table lists PIV as read/write.
Values marked (value x 0.1) or (value x 0.001) are raw and need scaling in the BMS.
Object names are the guide's short names; descriptions are the guide's object descriptions.

source.title: BACnet Integration Guidelines - CoolMasterNet, CooLinkNet, CooLinkHub, CooLinkBridge

integration.summary: Use these objects to monitor Daikin outdoor equipment only; control stays on the CoolMasterNet indoor-unit objects. Map the outdoor block's VA and trend the key temperatures, compressor data and error state.
integration.enable: BACnet must be enabled on the gateway; these objects belong to its PRO (service data) functionality.
setup: BACnet MS/TP: activate on line L3 with 'line type L3 BAC' (L4-L7 also possible on CoolMasterNet); default frame 9600 8N1, change with 'line baud L3 <rate>_8N1'; MAC (TS) default 0x40 = 64, change with 'line myid L3 <hex>'. Reboot after each change.
BACnet IP: enable with 'bacnet IP enable'; UDP port 47808 by default ('bacnet port <n>'). The server starts only once Ethernet is up with an IP address.
Default device instance 64 (0x40); change with 'bacnet instance <n>'.
gotchas: The guide does not document how VAs are assigned to outdoor units; confirm instances with a BACnet discovery.
